name: WorkflowMAX
description:
WorkflowMAX is job and practice management software for professional services firms – accountants, architects, engineers, consultants and creative agencies. This connector lets Claude read from and act on your WorkflowMAX organisation directly.
With it connected, you can ask Claude to:
- Look up jobs, clients and suppliers, and check job financials at a glance
- Create and manage jobs, tasks and costs, and assign staff
- Draft, issue and accept quotes, and manage quote line items
- Create and approve invoices against jobs
- Log and review timesheets, purchase orders and staff details
- Manage CRM leads and your cost and task catalogues

Instead of clicking through screens, you describe what you need in plain language – "show me every open job for this client and what's been invoiced" or "create a draft quote for the new engagement" – and Claude handles the lookup or the action, then summarises the result.

Ideal for practice managers, project leads and finance teams who want faster reporting, less manual data entry and a natural-language layer over their day-to-day workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WorkflowMAX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WorkflowMAX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.workflowmax.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WorkflowMAX MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WorkflowMAX lists 26 MCP tools, including accept_quote, add_job_note, approve_invoice, assign_staff, create_job_invoice, get_custom_field_definitions, get_invoices, get_job_financials, get_job_lookups, get_purchase_order, get_staff, and issue_quote.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WorkflowMAX?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to WorkflowMAX in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
WorkflowMAX requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WorkflowMAX is developed by WorkflowMAX. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
